intended_application: Human-agent assistance that retrieves approved knowledge and drafts replies during routine customer-support chats; a human approves every reply
organization: Riverton Service Partners, a fictional outsourced support provider used as a borderline teaching scenario
business_need: Improve routine-chat handling and retain contracts
capabilities_constraints: Scenario assumptions: a mix of hourly and outcome-based contracts, but no revenue split, margins, renewal terms, customer-volume trend, or local productivity results are supplied; human approval is required
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect drafts could harm service quality; human review and escalation are available
management_question: Is the proposed assistance a process improvement or a threat to the business model?
additional_context: All Riverton details are hypothetical. This borderline case tests whether the agent refuses to infer High or Potentially Existential disruption from sector alone.
